verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own Terraform provider is documented as a way to 'automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code', which gives a config-as-code path to versioning pipeline definitions. Review and rollback would depend on the surrounding Terraform/git workflow rather than any native in-product version history. missing for 10: native version history of connections/automations, built-in review or diff workflow, documented one-click rollback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
